delete.title: Move to trash?

duplicate.copyNotePublished: The copy takes the published text, the folder, the theme and the access. It opens in the editor as a draft, without publishing anything.
duplicate.sourceAddress: This is the address of the original presentation: change the title or the address.
duplicate.missingSourceLabel: Type the label of the original.
duplicate.missingVariantLabel: Type the label of the variant.
duplicate.variantAddressHelp: The address follows the title and the label of the variant until you change it: /slides/{slug}
